clean_description: The Marriage Plot follows Madeleine Hanna, an English major in the early 1980s, as she navigates her final year of college. Caught in a love triangle with the charismatic Leonard and the devoted Mitchell, Madeleine grapples with her romantic ideals influenced by classic literature versus the complexities of real-life relationships. The novel explores themes of love, identity, and the transition into adulthood with wit and insight.
